source_of_truth: Operator-locked product pivot (this plan's D001-D016 and the design conversation). One derived triage model is the single source of truth; the CLI operator brief, the operator-console GUI, and any agent all render the SAME model. The GUI is a first-class dual-mode operator console (observer + operator: glance, decide, hand off, confirm, inspect), not merely an inspectable evidence pane. Acceptance is operator-OUTCOME via named journeys on real producer state, not DOM-render correctness.
completion_test: On real fleet state, one derived triage model (deduped, gate-reconciled, with a data_quality envelope) drives every surface identically. `dontpanic operator brief --json` exposes the buckets with an allow-list vs an escalate-list (= needs_auth + needs_decision), surfaces uncertainty instead of fabricating, and an agent can boot from it to derive a run-plan + escalation list. The safe tier applies only auto_safe items opt-in/dry-run/logged/reversible (CLI engine), with a matching confirm-gated GUI affordance. The operator console shows ALL unique live human items (deduped + gate-reconciled, non-human buckets collapsed, NOT capped to a fixed number), lets the human decide/act/hand-off with confirm-gating + evidence on every mutating path, and makes the hidden/handled items inspectable. Separately, the real 313-item inventory collapses to its expected unique-human count. Each proven by a named-journey test, not DOM presence.

user_journeys.name: human-needs-you-triage
user_journeys.description: H1: a human sits down and asks 'does anything need me right now?' The default operator-console view shows ALL unique live needs_auth + needs_decision items (deduped + gate-reconciled, each one sentence + one action) and nothing else; everything agent-runnable/auto-safe/quiet is collapsed behind a single 'handled' affordance.
acceptance_signals: The default view shows ALL unique live needs_auth + needs_decision items, deduped and gate-reconciled, with non-human buckets collapsed (no hard count cap)
Separately: the real 313-item fleet fixture collapses to its expected unique-human count
Zero raw JSON and one honest status line

user_journeys.name: human-decide-a-gate
user_journeys.description: H3: a gate is waiting; the human opens it and decides from its evidence (audit findings, diff summary, plan acceptance, signoff) in place, without reading source.
acceptance_signals: A live gate's evidence is rendered enough to decide in place
Only LIVE gates appear (closed/abandoned plans reconciled out)

user_journeys.name: human-operator-acts
user_journeys.description: H7: the human operates directly from the console. Each item exposes a bucket-appropriate, confirm-gated, evidence-writing affordance: approve/request-changes/reject a gate via the governed action channel (or copy-command handoff), dry-run-then-confirm a safe-tier item, copy a command/run-plan for an agent. The human stays in DontPanic to decide and trigger, while execution may happen in a terminal/agent.
acceptance_signals: Every mutating action path is confirm-gated and writes/links an evidence record
Copy/handoff paths preserve the read-only contract (no silent execution)
The governed action channel is bounded to named buckets, never a general shell

user_journeys.name: human-audit-what-was-handled
user_journeys.description: H2/H6: the human verifies the agent's compression — what the agent/auto ran and changed (with evidence), and WHY each hidden item was suppressed (bucket + reason: deduped / stale-reconciled / info / agent-runnable).
acceptance_signals: A reverse-chron log shows agent/auto actions with evidence refs
The full inventory is inspectable with each item's bucket + reason
No item is silently hidden; uncertain items are surfaced

user_journeys.name: human-unblock-and-glance
user_journeys.description: H4/H5: when something is stuck the human sees the block, the one move, and the consequence; on a glance the install health is one honest line.
acceptance_signals: A blocked item shows its single unblock move and consequence
Health renders as one trustworthy line, not six stat tiles

user_journeys.name: agent-boot-and-escalate
user_journeys.description: A1/A2: the operator agent boots, reads operator brief --json, and derives a run-plan (agent_runnable + auto_safe, with commands, ordered by deps) plus a precise escalation list (needs_auth + needs_decision). It runs the safe set only and never touches human-gated items.
acceptance_signals: operator brief --json exposes per-item command/deps/evidence + allow-list vs escalate-list
The escalate-list equals needs_auth + needs_decision exactly
The agent runs nothing human-gated

user_journeys.name: agent-terminal-handoff
user_journeys.description: A5: GUI open beside a terminal/Cursor agent. The human hands work off from the console (copy run-plan, open-in-terminal/agent, send run-plan to a selected agent), the agent executes externally, and the result is marked-run + evidence-attached and refreshed back into the triage model so the console re-reads reality.
acceptance_signals: The console can hand a run-plan/command to a terminal or selected agent
External work can be marked-run with attached evidence
Refresh re-reads the F001 model after the external agent/terminal acted

user_journeys.name: agent-honesty-under-uncertainty
user_journeys.description: A3/A4: the agent reports back truthfully what it ran (feeding the human log), and when classification is incomplete it narrates the uncertain items + data-quality warnings rather than fabricating a clean bucket.
acceptance_signals: The brief carries a data_quality block (counts, uncertain, staleness) and an embedded honesty contract
Incomplete classification surfaces as uncertain, never fabricated
What the agent ran is recorded with evidence for the human to audit

user_journeys.name: operator-applies-safe-tier
user_journeys.description: Safe-tier application: the operator (human via the console, or agent via CLI) applies only auto_safe (reversible derived-state) items, dry-run first, logged and reversible, never credentials/approvals/project mutations. Off by default. The GUI affordance drives the same CLI engine.
acceptance_signals: Dry-run is the default and mutates nothing
Confirm applies only auto_safe items and writes a reversible evidence record
needs_auth / needs_decision / project-mutating items are refused; GUI and CLI share one engine
